displayName: OCI-AI-PD-030: AI — Prompt Injection via Image/Document Upload
description:
Detects indirect prompt injection through uploaded images, PDFs, or documents containing hidden instructions

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — prompt injection via image/document upload

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_030", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%injection%') AND "value" > 0
